properties.name: app.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated list of allowed origins for CORS requests.

properties.name: api.security.token.secret
properties.description: Secret used to sign and verify JWT tokens for API authentication.

properties.name: spring.mail.host
properties.description: SMTP server hostname used to send outgoing email.

properties.name: spring.mail.port
properties.description: SMTP server port number used for email delivery.

properties.name: spring.mail.username
properties.description: Username for SMTP authentication when sending email.

properties.name: spring.mail.password
properties.description: Password for SMTP authentication. Keep this value secure and do not commit it to source control.

properties.name: spring.mail.properties.mail.smtp.auth
properties.description: Enable SMTP authentication by setting this to true when the mail server requires login credentials.

properties.name: spring.mail.properties.mail.smtp.starttls.enable
properties.description: Enable STARTTLS for SMTP connections to secure email transport if supported by the server.

properties.name: gemini.api.key
properties.description: API key used to authenticate requests to the Gemini service.

properties.name: gemini.api.url
properties.description: Base URL for the Gemini API endpoint.

properties.name: abacatepay.api.key
properties.description: API key used to authenticate requests to the AbacatePay service.

properties.name: abacatepay.api.base-url
properties.description: Base URL for AbacatePay API requests.

properties.name: abacatepay.webhook.secret
properties.description: Secret used to verify incoming AbacatePay webhook requests.
